items: Thank you to ichin23 for the first community contribution: Desk Buddy should now fill the whole screen on newer Kindles (firmware 5.16 and later, e.g. Paperwhite 5, Signature Edition, Kindle Basic), and it adds Exit to Kindle, Flip screen and a Compact screen size

Album covers look much better on the Kindle: twice as sharp (Settings › Music › Cover quality) and tuned for e-ink, so dark covers aren't muddy any more (the idea comes from Kindle Photo Prep by kuslota)
Added: Go back to the previous version (About › Updates), in case an update gives you trouble
Added: Desk Buddy now checks for new versions by itself and installs them when you click Install (About › Updates)
Bigger Kindle screens work (Paperwhite 3, 4, 5, Signature Edition, Oasis), from 1.1
